errors.evidence: The list of countries on the x-axis omits 'Dänemark', which is present in the chart between 'Südkorea' and 'Deutschland'.

errors.text_span: Japan, Schweden, Südkorea, Deutschland, Vereinigtes Königreich, OECD, Polen, EU27, USA, Italien, Spanien und Frankreich
errors.evidence: The order of the listed countries does not match the order on the chart's x-axis. For instance, 'Vereinigtes Königreich' is listed before 'OECD' and 'USA', but it appears after them in the chart.

errors.text_span: die Ticks sind alle 10 Prozentpunkte konzentriert
errors.evidence: The phrasing 'konzentriert' (concentrated) is awkward and unclear. A better phrasing would be 'sind in Abständen von 10 Prozentpunkten' (are at intervals of 10 percentage points).
The bar for Japan is clearly higher than 85%, at approximately 88%.
The bar for Südkorea is at the 80% mark, not 78%.
The bar for Deutschland is at approximately 78%, not 76%.
The bar for OECD is visibly above the 70% line, at approximately 72%, not 68%.
The bar for Polen is on the 70% line, not 65%.
The bar for EU27 is on the 70% line, not 67%.
The bar for Italien is visibly higher than 63%, at approximately 68%.
The bar for Spanien is visibly higher than 61%, at approximately 66%.

errors.text_span: Der Balken für das Vereinigte Königreich ist deutlich niedriger als die anderen Balken
errors.evidence: This is a factually incorrect and subjective statement. The bar for the United Kingdom is not an outlier and is not 'deutlich niedriger' (significantly lower) than all other bars; it is part of a descending trend.
The description fails to mention that the bars for 'OECD' and 'EU27' have a different color from the other bars, which is a significant visual distinction.
